As filed in the issue body:

    dxc.exe /T lib_6_6 /Zpr /all_resources_bound /Zi /Od /Vn"g_DefaultRT_DXIL_Lib" /Fh"DefaultRT.dxil-lib.h" /nologo DefaultRT.hlsl

cmd.txt departs from it in three ways, all recorded here because a repro that quietly
changes the reported configuration has measured something else:

1. `/Vn` and `/Fh` dropped. They only name and write a C header holding the DXIL container;
   nothing about the reported symptom depends on them, and they would write a file into the
   issue directory on every probe.
2. `/`-style switches written as `-`. dxc accepts both spellings for these flags. `-Zpr` is
   confirmed honoured in the captured output (`row_major float4x4 projectionViewWorld` in
   the cbuffer dump); `-all_resources_bound` is confirmed by the module flags metadata,
   which reads `!{i32 0, i64 273}` with the flag and `!{i32 0, i64 17}` without it
   (0x100 = all-resources-bound), and by the recorded command line in the DXIL
   (`!"-T", !"lib_6_6", !"-Zpr", !"-all_resources_bound", ...`) -- both visible in
   out-main-debug.txt. Unrecognised `/`-flags are silently ignored by dxc, so this is
   checked rather than assumed.
3. `RootFlags(XBOX_RAYTRACING)` in the attached DefaultRT.hlsl is replaced by `RootFlags(0)`.
   Stock dxc rejects the Xbox-only flag outright:

       DefaultRT.hlsl:5:5: error: root signature error - Expected a root signature flag
       value, found: 'XBOX_RAYTRACING'
       exit 0x80004005

   captured in variant-as-filed-xbox-flag-main-debug.txt. Without this change every probe
   dies in the root-signature parser and measures nothing about vector indexing -- the
   `invalid-probe` trap. Nothing else in the file is touched, so line and column numbers
   still match the attachment (the out-of-bounds subscript is line 124, col 118).

The original attachment is preserved verbatim in attach/ (downloaded from the issue).
